base.inference_policy: Frozen old190 stone + A0model1 fiber, FP32/batch1/native softmax bilinear align_cornersFalse; unchanged fiber-priority mapping. Unadopted research base; retain frozen classwise3 quality reference. No new training initialization from mixed A0.

input.common: NativeBGR->RGB->PIL.Image bilinear resize256x256 exactly once; uint8 grid->float32 RGB in[0,1]. Stone always receives original grid after original ImageNet normalization.
input.raw2: Exact original preprocessing via existing pil_input/_tensor; both networks consume same original tensor, no duplicated transfer to inflate baseline.
input.transform_order: Fiber transform AFTER shared PIL resize, BEFORE ImageNet normalization, no return to uint8 or second resize. Transform encoded display RGB, NOT radiometrically calibrated exposure.
input.fiber_vlift: v=max(R,G,B). Forv>0, Cnew=(C/v)*v^gamma for ALL channels using same scalar; v=0=>RGB0. float32, clip only roundoff to[0,1]. No hue/saturation veto. Preserves normalized RGB chromaticity before float error.
input.fiber_channel_gamma: Cnew=C^gamma independently for ALL channels, float32, clip only roundoff. Same max-channel value v^gamma as fiber_vlift, different channel ratios.
input.interpretation: Two transformed arms match HSV V mathematically, not Lab lightness/luminance/local contrast. Cannot interpret arm differences as pure hue or pure illumination causality. Gamma0.7 is one engineering hypothesis, not fitted on validation frames; no sweep/adaptation/CLAHE/Retinex or per-video normalization.
input.deployment_graph: Exactly1original stone forward +1selected transformed fiber forward perframe. Two weight instances. No original-fiber extra pass, TTA ensemble, maxprob fusion, historical probability lookup, cache-based pixel protection or GT-driven ROI.
input.mapping: Each branch softmax on its own256grid; both3class maps FP32 bilinear to native; stone argmax1 then fiber argmax2 priority exactly as base. No changed segmentation threshold, morphology/template/geometry/temporal correction.

config.output_role: Diagnostic input-response masks, not adopted corrected masks. Stone PROBABILITIES unchanged, but new fiber can cover formerly stone pixels; no claim that raw stone masks or high-confidence original fiber pixels are protected. Audit both classes, gross lostTP and all failures. Original RGB/GT coordinates unchanged in evaluation and displays.

Full decode/render/audit/export fps, CPU/GPU peaks and instances/forward counts. Direct same-run comparisons, no percentile subtraction.
